tool_definitions.name: notify
tool_definitions.description: send a desktop notification when the terminal is not focused

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: notification text, as plain text: write < and & as themselves, never as HTML entities

parameters.name: icon
parameters.description: notification icon: (one of success, info, warning, error, question, progress)
